2026-11-23 | test copy of a pattern sheet for the v3.2 gateway; the live sheet is reply_patterns.md

## Hooks

### H1 - Question first, one concrete detail
Description: The whole reply is one question about a specific part of the build or claim.
Type: Clean

### H2 - One noticed detail, then the question
Description: One short sentence naming a single detail, then a question about it.
Type: Clean

## Do not use

- X1 - Verdict on the post as the opening (their term, then a judgement on it).

## Not known yet

- Profile visits per hook.
